The idea

Your old tank keeps forty gallons hot all day, every day — just in case. We thought that was a strange way to make a shower.

01 / DESIGN

Built to disappear.

A matte-black unit about the size of a carry-on hangs on the wall and frees up the floor your tank used to take.

  • Wall-mounted, compact body
  • Powder-coated matte finish
02 / CONTROL

Set it to the degree.

The touch display holds your water at exactly the temperature you choose, so the tap runs the same every time.

  • Digital temperature readout
  • One-touch up / down
03 / INSIDE

Cold in. Hot out.

Open a tap and water flows through the heat exchanger, heating as it passes. When the tap closes, the burner stops.

  • Heats only while water flows
  • No standby heat loss
04 / EVERYDAY

Every tap. Every room.

Back-to-back showers, a full dishwasher, laundry at the same time. The water stays hot for as long as it runs.

  • Showers, kitchen & laundry
  • Steady flow throughout the house
05 / ENDLESS

Endless hot water. Engineered on demand.

This is the whole idea: hot water that never runs out, without keeping a tank hot all day.

Endless hot water

Efficient by design
